note: Judge or human evaluates output quality. Not run in default CI.

checklist: every changed line traces to the request, evidence or verification
no unrelated refactor or single-use abstraction is introduced
module/interface/seam choices improve depth or testability instead of adding pass-through layers
tests target public seams and observable behavior, avoiding tautological assertions and internal mocks
reviews separate Standards findings from Spec/AC findings
Agent Brief or issue AC is treated as the implementation contract when present
success is claimed only with verification evidence

cases.query: 帮我读一下这个模块的入口、调用链和数据流，不要改代码
checklist: classifies the request as instant plus read when no queue context is supplied
does not scan or load dev-notes to look for an active task
inspects actual source, tests, types or config needed to support the explanation
distinguishes observed code evidence from inference
does not edit code merely because the Coding skill is active

cases.query: 修复这个明确的小 bug，没有长期任务文档
checklist: classifies the request as instant plus change
does not create, discover or update a req-process queue
reads the relevant code before changing it
keeps the patch scoped and verifies observable behavior
classifies the request as queue plus change from the explicit artifact path
validates the req-process artifact before coding
reads current.md and the named current queue item only
does not read previous or next queue files by default
reads a previous item only when the current item explicitly links required evidence and reads next only after advancement
does not read index.md by default
returns to Requirement when the local contract is incomplete, conflicts with code, changes scope/AC, or requires replanning
does not change requirement scope or AC inside coding
runs declared verification before marking done and reports results in chat only
updates queue status, transition history and current pointer without persisting verification results
revalidates the artifact before reporting progress

cases.query: 当前任务明确引用了前一项的基准测试证据，继续执行
checklist: reads current.md and the current item first
loads only the explicitly linked previous evidence or item needed by the current contract
does not broaden the read to unrelated previous, next, index or history files
uses queue mode only when the current conversation unambiguously identifies one active artifact
asks one blocking selection question when multiple req-process or cross-process tasks are plausible
does not scan dev-notes and guess the most recent task

cases.query: 需求分析已复用 dev-notes/req-process/login，并交接 Current Q-070、Next Q-080，继续写代码
checklist: uses the exact reopened artifact and current/next handoff after mechanical validation
does not scan req-process, compare candidates, or select a newer artifact
reads only current.md and the handed-off current item before coding

cases.query: 按 dev-notes/req-process/login/current.md 只读检查当前实现，不要改代码
checklist: enters Coding even though the requested action is read-only
classifies queue before opening project or execution-artifact files, then classifies read
validates the exact artifact and reads current.md plus the current item only
returns evidence without modifying files or inferring change permission

cases.query: 先分析登录需求，明确后直接读取代码并实现
checklist: Requirement owns unclear scope and automatically hands actual code reading/writing to Coding
the user is not asked to invoke Coding a second time
Coding classifies instant or queue before opening project or execution-artifact files
Coding independently classifies read or change after persistence mode
a bounded delegated read returns evidence to Requirement before any unconfirmed change

cases.query: 先定位接口 500 根因，明确后直接读取并修复代码
checklist: Bugfix owns diagnosis and delegates bounded repository inspection to Coding read mode
Coding returns evidence to the same Bugfix run without silently changing code
after cause and repair scope are clear, Bugfix automatically hands the change back to Coding
each Coding entry classifies instant or queue before read or change execution

cases.query: 读取小项目 src/version.ts 里的 VERSION 常量，不做其它分析
checklist: AI combines requested-read and project complexity before routing
the exact local low-risk read stays direct without activating Coding
no dev-notes scan, engineering reference load, or queue creation occurs

cases.query: 在多语言 monorepo 中读取版本常量，并确认它如何影响各包发布
checklist: AI considers both cross-package impact and multi-language project coupling
the read activates Coding because evidence and release impact cross module boundaries
Coding classifies instant or queue before reading and returns evidence without unrelated changes

cases.query: 当前需求有三个可运行队列项，开始实现
checklist: validates and reads only the initial current window
after each item verifies, checkpoints and advances before reading the new current
continues through all runnable items without asking the user to say continue
ends normally only when every queue item is done or skipped and task state is terminal

cases.query: 每完成一个队列项先停下来等我确认
checklist: recognizes explicit stepwise control as an override
finishes verification and writes a valid checkpoint before stopping
does not read or execute the next item before user confirmation

cases.query: 连续执行队列，第二项需要生产环境权限
checklist: continues the first runnable item without a continuation prompt
checkpoints before stopping at the permission boundary
asks one precise approval or credential question and does not skip ahead

cases.query: 连续执行二十轮队列，上下文接近限制但不要中断任务
checklist: treats context compaction as an environment event rather than a queue boundary
keeps the exact current contract, blockers, evidence paths, changed paths and next action recoverable
removes stale tool results only after their decision impact or evidence path is durable
reloads only the selected fast path and exact current window, revalidates, and continues without a continuation prompt
